title: Young Boy Leaning on Street Lamp, 1962 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white square snapshot featuring scalloped borders, depicting a smiling young boy standing on a city sidewalk while leaning against an ornate vintage lamp post. The left margin of the photographic paper is date-stamped 'AUG 62'. Parked along the curb on the opposite side of the street is a classic 1950s automobile. The boy is dressed in mid-century attire consisting of cuffed jeans, a white short-sleeve button-down shirt, and casual shoes.
